name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
benefit: Collateral-free loan up to ₹3 lakh, 5% interest, free skill training and toolkit
benefit_hindi: ₹3 lakh tak bina guarantee ka loan, 5% byaaj, muft training aur toolkit

eligibility.description: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with their hands in 18 identified trades
eligibility.description_hindi: Haath se kaam karne wale paramparik kaarigar — 18 pehchaan kiye gaye vyavsaay
criteria: Traditional artisan/craftsperson in one of 18 trades
Trades include: carpenter, blacksmith, goldsmith, potter, weaver, cobbler, barber, washerman, tailor, fishnet maker, toy maker, etc.
Age 18+, self-employed, working in unorganized sector
Should not be a member of other similar schemes
exclusions: Beneficiaries of similar central schemes like PM SVANidhi, MUDRA

steps: Visit nearest CSC center or pmvishwakarma.gov.in
Register with Aadhaar and mobile number
Get verified by Gram Panchayat/Urban Local Body
Receive PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card
Apply for loan up to ₹1 lakh (first), then ₹2 lakh more
steps_hindi: Nearest CSC center ya pmvishwakarma.gov.in par jaayein
Aadhaar aur mobile number se register karein
PM Vishwakarma certificate aur ID card milega
₹1 lakh ka loan lein, phir ₹2 lakh aur mil sakta hai

hindi_summary: PM Vishwakarma Yojana mein kaarigaroon ko muft training, toolkit, aur 3 lakh rupaye tak ka sasta loan milta hai. Badhai, lohar, kumhar, darzi — sab apply kar sakte hain. CSC center ya online apply karein.
